name: print-social-language-school-project-case-slide-magenta-starbursts
title: Project slide with feed grid, bold-lead text and magenta starbursts on cream
whatItIs: A cream slide with tiny corner labels, a giant heavy brown title, description paragraphs with bold lead-ins, a 3x3 feed grid of colourful posts at right, big magenta starbursts in two corners and a script outline sticker 'project 7'.
whatItMeans: Warm and professional; the magenta accent and script sticker add personality.
techniques: Show a 3x3 feed grid as a boxed image next to text.
Anchor corners with large magenta starbursts.
Use bold lead-ins for About and Result.
Overlap a script sticker on the image corner.

vocabulary.definition: A 3x3 grid image summarising a feed.
A large shape cropped in a slide corner.
A bold phrase opening a paragraph.
